Lab 02: Cloud Data Encryption with TensorFlow

Objective:
Design and implement a neural network model for simulating cloud data encryption.

Plaintext:
Hello TensorFlow

Binary Plaintext:
01001000011001010110110001101100011011110010000001010100011001010110111001110011011011110111001001000110011011000110111101110111

Encrypted Binary Target:
10110111100110101001001110010011100100001101111110101011100110101001000110001100100100001000110110111001100100111001000010001000

Predicted Encrypted Binary:
10110111100110101001001110010011100100001101111110101011100110101001000110001100100100001000110110111001100100111001000010001000

Decrypted Text:
Hello TensorFlow

Conclusion:
A TensorFlow neural network was trained to learn a simple binary encryption mapping.
This is a learning simulation and not a replacement for real cryptographic encryption.
